author: Mary Austin
title: The Land of Little Rain
edition: Boston and New York: Houghton, Mifflin and Company, 1903; title page and copyright page identify the edition. Prose line wraps are reflowed to spaces; paragraph boundaries and poetry line/stanza breaks are retained. Outer block whitespace, illustration markers, and publisher/digitizer matter are omitted; original transcription punctuation and emphasis conventions are retained. Text follows the Project Gutenberg plain-text file, including its underscore emphasis and double-hyphen dash conventions.

rights.basis: This original English text/edition was published in 1903, before 1931, and its US publication term has expired as of 2026. Project Gutenberg explicitly identifies this transcription as public domain in the USA.

acquisition.method: Project Gutenberg 51893 plain text (UTF-8) from the PG mirror aleph.pglaf.org. Removed the PG header and footer, cover and title-page imprint, copyright leaf, the publishers' note on the illustrations, contents, illustration markers and captions, the printer's imprint and the transcriber's notes; kept the dedication, the author's preface and all fourteen chapters. Lines of each paragraph joined with single spaces; passages whose lines are all indented (verse) kept as stanza lines with indentation removed. Chapter titles are level-2 headings under the book title.
